why: GAME_WIRING stops being an allowlist: any game module may import any render or audio module, so the check degrades to the pre-#473 world where hud.ts learned a colour from render/entities.ts. The real tree passes under it. 3 of 84 in dependency-direction.test.ts: `flags game -> render from a non-wiring import` (hud.ts, which IS listed -- for audio/manifest -- so this also pins that the list is per target module), `flags game -> audio from a file with no wiring entry` and `flags a wiring file reaching a render module it is not listed for` (loop.ts -> render/entities). The clean wiring fixtures and the layer-pair coverage test pass either way: the mutation widens the allowlist, not MAY_IMPORT.
